persona.name: Ines Calloway
persona.situation: 38, middle-school science teacher in Bramwell, lives alone with a grey cat; plays a secondhand ukulele, writes songs and paints watercolours; training back from a knee injury toward a half marathon; uses the assistant as a companion across a year of ordinary life: family, friends, health and feelings.
persona.voice: warm, dry and self-deprecating; writes in bursts whose shape follows her mood; drops small specific details about people, places and her body in passing, and rarely repeats them
